text:
incident-bot: 🚨 PROD canary healthcheck failing for rollout 2024-11-07 — service= inference-api-canary. Healthcheck: 3/5 failed in last 60s. Pager routed to @dave.
incident-bot: Pager: <https://pager.example/incident/1700024680|open pager>

maya: seeing elevated 500s on /v1/generate, 95th latency spiking for canary nodes.
maya: logs show repeated upstream timeouts and heavy KV cache miss rate.

dave: oncall here, looking. paging SRE lead.
sre-lead: thanks — what's the customer impact? any errors from paid tenants?
maya: ~=2% of traffic on canary. A handful of streaming clients report stalls. Support got 1 ticket so far (INC-1234).
support-tier2: INC-1234: Acme reports intermittent failures generating snippets since 02:10 UTC. Captured user request ids attached.

ops-bot: Suggested action: flip feature flag `redwood_canary_2024_11` -> off (kill-switch). Runbook step recommends toggle + drain, then rollback if errors persist.
maya: initiating manual kill-switch now.
maya: ```./infra/flags/flip redwood_canary_2024_11 --env prod --actor maya``` :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Feature flag toggled successfully. New traffic allocation: canary=0%, stable=100%. Draining started.

dave: initiating manual rollback to previous stable revision rev-20241107-a to be safe.
maya: runbook step 3: scale down canary and confirm no new pods behind LB.
maya: ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-api-canary --to-revision=rev-20241107-a```

sre-lead: collecting verification artifacts — nginx access logs, kube events for canary pods, heap snapshots if needed. Post S3 path when ready.
maya: grabbing logs now and filtering recent 500s.
maya: ```tail -n 200 /var/log/nginx/canary-access.log | grep 500 | head -n 50```
maya: snippet: "2024-11-07T02:12:34Z GET /v1/generate 500 upstream_timeout host=canary-12 request_id=abc123"

dave: dashboards show latency returning to baseline after flag flip; 95th ~180ms across stable nodes. Errors on canary drop to 0 after drain.
ops-bot: Note: automated rollback did not trigger — healthcheck threshold had been overridden in this rollout (manual threshold = 50% failed before auto rollback).
sre-lead: ok, manual path executed correctly. We need 15m of clean telemetry before marking mitigated. Continue monitoring.
support-tier2: I'll update INC-1234 and CC customers: mitigated, temporary rollback and follow-up RCA planned.

maya: collecting full artifact bundle and uploading to S3: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1700024680/artifacts.tar.gz (includes kube events, pod logs, nginx logs, exporter metrics).
dave: please add runner trace and KV cache metrics snapshot to that archive.
maya: added.

sre-lead: handing off to night ops for RCA and postmortem follow-up. I'll join async. Key investigation items: reproduce KV cache miss spike, kernel I/O for canary hosts, any config diff between canary and stable.
dave: nights, please ack and start extended data capture (heap/profile + perf counters) for 1h window. Also preserve logs for 7d.
oncall-night: acked, taking over. Starting heap/profile capture window now and will preserve node images. Collector started, pid=4421.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to MITIGATED by dave at 1700024725 — reason: manual kill-switch + rollback succeeded, 15m clean window started.

maya: leaving handoff notes in the incident doc: https://confluence.example/incidents/1700024680 — will attach initial hypotheses and what to check first.
support-tier2: Ticket updated to customers with mitigation and next steps for RCA.

dave: thanks team. If any new degradation appears, page immed. Otherwise we move to RCA cadence tomorrow. :thumbsup:
